threads.body: [Style] Classes under `javaagent/src/main/` should not be declared `final`. Remove the modifier from this helper class.

replies.body:
Addressed in 881820e994c337ab3765906363567d7f12a8bed3.

Analysis: The package-private Log4jConfig helpers live under javaagent/src/main, and the nested TestHandler helpers live in test code. Repository style explicitly disallows final classes in both locations, so removing only the class modifiers brings both paired modules into compliance without changing behavior.

Upsides: Aligns the Log4j 1.2 and 2.17 implementations with repository class-modifier rules and keeps their parallel structure consistent.

Downsides: The classes no longer encode a non-subclassing constraint, but they remain non-public implementation and test helpers.

threads.body: [Style] Helper methods should appear before nested classes. Move `include` above `ContextDataAccessorImpl` so nested classes remain the final section of the class.

replies.body:
Addressed in 0218356aa17995a8adbe8ad234aba9c921e67e9c.

Analysis: The include helper was declared after the ContextDataAccessorImpl nested enum, contrary to the repository's methods-before-nested-classes organization rule. Moving the unchanged helper above the enum restores the expected class layout without affecting calls or behavior.

Upsides: Keeps the nested type as the final class section and makes the test structure consistent with repository organization guidance.

Downsides: No material downside identified.
